scope: Bounded source and production API trace inspection after Next.js 16.3.8 upgrade

groups.observation: Installed Anchor workspace helper parses a local Anchor.toml file and explicitly rejects browser workspace access. Application source does not call Anchor workspace or parse TOML.
groups.limitation: This does not clear every transitive SDK path or future use.

groups.observation: Application source does not start a gRPC server or call getAuthContext. Circle SDK is dynamically loaded from client components. Collections server integration uses native fetch to a fixed Circle origin.
groups.limitation: Client SDK internals are not fully audited.

groups.observation: Remaining production-audit nodes are nested under Firebase. No application source imports these nested modules directly.
groups.limitation: The Node runtime's built-in fetch is separate and was not audited through this npm dependency report.

productionTraceInspection.limitation: Trace absence is supporting evidence for the inspected API bundles, not a formal reachability proof for browser code, pages or SDK internals.

releaseDecision: Keep the controlled pilot separate. Do not advertise a clean dependency audit or general production readiness. Review upstream-compatible remediation before increasing exposure.
